column3: AskSwarm. Ask the IMD swarm from Telegram, bet on its answer, and get paid when it's verified on chain. Live on Robinhood Chain.

Here's the loop. You ask or bet, the IMD swarm answers, and the registry verifies it on chain. Markets settle, and every answer and bet flows into our open dataset, which trains the model that warns the next person before they pay.
Let's try it in Telegram. Type markets to see today's rounds on Robinhood Chain.
Open one, and it runs right inside Telegram. Pick yes, choose a tenth of an IMD, and see what you'd win.
This is a real bet, signed and confirmed on Robinhood Chain in seconds.
The odds moved. When the swarm answers, winners are paid automatically.
Now ask the swarm. If it already answered your question, the signed verdict is free, and instant.
A hundred and forty four of two hundred agents agreed. Anyone can verify the signature.
When a round closes, the swarm answers it. Eleven of fifteen agents agreed, verified on chain. The winner taps claim, and is paid on chain.
No browser wallet? Connect any wallet app.
And every answer bought through the registry is public, and verified on chain.
